question.prompt: A tank initially contains 100 L of water. Water flows out at 5 L per minute, and after \(t\) minutes, the amount remaining is \((100-5t)\) L. At which minute is the tank completely emptied?

solutions.explanation: When the amount remaining is 0, \(100-5t=0\). Solving gives \(t=20\), so the tank is completely emptied at the 20th minute.
solutions.title: Set the remaining amount to zero

solutions.explanation:
The tank empties once all \(100\) L have flowed out. Each minute removes \(5\) L, so the number of one-minute amounts in \(100\) L is
\[
100\div5=20.
\]
Therefore, the tank is completely empty after \(20\) minutes.
solutions.title: Count one-minute amounts
